headline_seed: Far-right AfD wins vote in Germany’s Saxony-Anhalt state: Exit polls - Al Jazeera
draft_text:
Germany's far-right AfD took ~44% in Saxony-Anhalt Sunday, per NBC News — more than double its share five years ago. CDU fell to 18.5%. Whether AfD can form a government remains unclear.

And that's the mews.
